title: Settings — status dot lined up with its text

steps.path: Settings → the Backup & Sync and Remote Access rows
steps.headline: The dot now sits level with the middle of the status text instead of slightly below it.
steps.changed: The dot is now centred on the height of the capital letters beside it. Before, it lined up with the middle of the small letters, which put it a little low. Both rows use the same shared piece, so they stay matched.
steps.measured: Dot raised 1 to 2 px; its centre now matches the text centre to the pixel
steps.notice: "Sync Failing" and "Disabled" read as level with their dots. Zoom in on the page to compare Before and After closely.
steps.risk: The move is tiny, so on a small screen it may be hard to see. Long status text is still cut off with "…" as before.
